translations.Name: Name
translations.Generates parametric architectural grid:
Generates parametric architectural grid axes (structural gridlines) from lists of
spacing distances between consecutive X and Y axes.
Connect directly to Panel nodes (multi-line or comma-separated numbers) or numeric lists.
Outputs axis curves (X lines, Y lines), bubble markers, intersection points for columns/foundations, and a 3D wireframe mesh.
translations.Generates a watertight monolithic concre: Generates a watertight monolithic concrete stair flight.
translations.Generates 3D watertight parametric hip r:
Generates 3D watertight parametric hip roofs via Straight Skeleton from any boundary contour or referenced face, with optional courtyard/interior holes.
Supports both horizontal roofs and sloped/tilted 3D surfaces.
translations.Generates a 3D watertight solid floor sl: Generates a 3D watertight solid floor slab or foundation from a boundary curve.
translations.Extrudes a 2D polyline or curve into 3D: Extrudes a 2D polyline or curve into 3D watertight solid walls with thickness and height.
translations.Generates a closed circular polyline cur: Generates a closed circular polyline curve and optional planar face.
translations.Generates an elliptical polyline with in: Generates an elliptical polyline with independent X and Y radii.
translations.Generates a planar 2D/3D polygon face me: Generates a planar 2D/3D polygon face mesh from boundary vertices and optional hole loops.
translations.Generates a structural steel I-beam or H: Generates a structural steel I-beam or H-profile cross section.
translations.Generates an architectural or structural: Generates an architectural or structural L-shape polyline.
translations.Generates a straight 3D line curve conne: Generates a straight 3D line curve connecting start point A and end point B.
translations.Extracts vertices or boundary points fro: Extracts vertices or boundary points from any input curve or surface / planar mesh.
translations.Generates a regular polygon (triangle, p: Generates a regular polygon (triangle, pentagon, hexagon, octagon, etc.).
translations.Generates a rectangular polyline with op: Generates a rectangular polyline with optional rounded fillet corners.
translations.Generates a pill / stadium / elongated s: Generates a pill / stadium / elongated slot polyline.
translations.Generates a 2D or 3D Archimedean spiral: Generates a 2D or 3D Archimedean spiral or helical stair path.
translations.Generates an n-pointed parametric star p: Generates an n-pointed parametric star polyline.
translations.Samples an image file (PNG/JPG/BMP) or p:
Samples an image file (PNG/JPG/BMP) or procedural ripple to produce a 3D terrain
displacement mesh, point cloud, and brightness values (0.0 to 1.0).
Click '🖼️ Select Image' on the node card to pick a file from disk.
translations.Integer number slider with customizable: Integer number slider with customizable limits and step value.
translations.Floating-point number slider with decima: Floating-point number slider with decimal precision and customizable limits.
translations.Grasshopper-style multi-line data inspec:
Grasshopper-style multi-line data inspector and input panel.
• When wired: acts as a data viewer, formatting items with indices [0], [1]...
• When unwired: type multi-line numbers, text, or coordinates (x, y, z) to output as lists.
Sleek Grasshopper-style boolean switch. Click the button to toggle between True and False.
translations.Assigns a material (Glass, Wood, Aluminu:
Assigns a material (Glass, Wood, Aluminum, Concrete, etc.), color, and opacity
to geometry. When multiple parts are merged into an assembly (window, door),
each part preserves its material and transparency when baked to IngeTrazo.
translations.Defines an RGB color tuple (0.0 to 1.0): Defines an RGB color tuple (0.0 to 1.0) and hex code.
translations.Combines separate parts (e.g. glass pane:
Combines separate parts (e.g. glass panes and wood frames) into a single assembly.
Preserves each part's assigned material, color, and opacity so the entire assembly
bakes cleanly into IngeTrazo as a multi-material window, door, or architectural element.
translations.Performs Cartesian cross-referencing bet: Performs Cartesian cross-referencing between two lists.
Divides input A by input B.
translations.Divides a numeric range or interval into: Divides a numeric range or interval into N equal steps.
translations.Evaluates a mathematical formula express: Evaluates a mathematical formula expression f(x, y).
translations.Generates an arithmetic series of number: Generates an arithmetic series of numbers.
Subtracts input B from input A.
translations.Reverses the face winding / normal orien:
Reverses the face winding / normal orientation of a 3D mesh (turning inside-out),
or reverses the direction of a curve.
translations.Exports geometry and assemblies to the I: Exports geometry and assemblies to the IngeTrazo 3D scene with BIM metadata (IfcColumn, IfcWall, etc.).
translations.Reference a face or surface from the Ing:
Reference a face or surface from the IngeTrazo 3D viewport into the node graph.
Click '📌 Set Selected Face' on the node card to store the currently selected face.
Automatically extracts the outer perimeter and all courtyard/interior holes.
The referenced face is saved directly in the file (.itgraph) so it is remembered
when reopening.
translations.Generates a 3D watertight cuboid / box s: Generates a 3D watertight cuboid / box solid.
translations.Generates a 3D watertight cylinder or ar: Generates a 3D watertight cylinder or architectural column solid.
translations.Extrudes any 2D closed curve or polygon: Extrudes any 2D closed curve or polygon into a 3D watertight solid with capped ends.
translations.Joins a list of meshes into a single com: Joins a list of meshes into a single combined watertight mesh.
translations.Generates a 3D mesh surface from a grid: Generates a 3D mesh surface from a grid or array of points.
translations.Creates a watertight cylindrical pipe or:
Creates a watertight cylindrical pipe or hollow tube solid along rail curve(s).
Uses rotation-minimizing parallel transport frames to avoid twisting.
Supports radius, wall thickness, radial segments, and capping options.
translations.Revolves a 2D profile curve around the Z: Revolves a 2D profile curve around the Z axis into a 3D solid.
translations.Generates a 3D watertight UV sphere soli: Generates a 3D watertight UV sphere solid.
translations.Sweeps a 2D/3D profile curve along a rai:
Sweeps a 2D/3D profile curve along a rail trajectory path using rotation-minimizing
parallel transport frames to produce a smooth watertight solid or tubular surface.
Supports open or closed profiles and paths, with automatic start and end capping.
translations.Merges multiple solids or meshes into a: Merges multiple solids or meshes into a single compound geometry.
translations.Applies translation, rotation, and unifo: Applies translation, rotation, and uniform scaling to 3D geometry.
translations.Deconstructs a point or vector into its: Deconstructs a point or vector into its X, Y, Z coordinate components.
translations.Calculates Euclidean distance between tw: Calculates Euclidean distance between two points.
translations.Generates a 2D regular grid of points wi: Generates a 2D regular grid of points with spacing and counts.
translations.Performs vector arithmetic (Addition, Su: Performs vector arithmetic (Addition, Subtraction, Dot Product, Cross Product, Normalization).
translations.Constructs an orthonormal 3D plane coord:
Constructs an orthonormal 3D plane coordinate system from an origin point and normal vector.
Emits origin, unit normal, unit U (X-axis in plane), unit V (Y-axis in plane), a visual preview rectangle, and a plane dictionary.
translations.Constructs a 3D point from X, Y, Z coord: Constructs a 3D point from X, Y, Z coordinates.
translations.Duplicates geometry N times along a step: Duplicates geometry N times along a step vector.
translations.Moves 3D geometry or points by translati: Moves 3D geometry or points by translation vector (dX, dY, dZ).
translations.Duplicates geometry N times in a circula: Duplicates geometry N times in a circular radial pattern around an origin.
translations.Rotates 3D geometry around Z axis by ang: Rotates 3D geometry around Z axis by angle in degrees.
translations.Extrudes any 2D planar face, surface, or: Extrudes any 2D planar face, surface, or annular frame (including holes) into a watertight 3D solid with capped ends.
translations.Clean, lightweight viewport visualizer.\:
Clean, lightweight viewport visualizer.
Connect any geometry (Mesh, Curve, Surface, Solids) to preview it immediately in the IngeTrazo 3D viewport.
No BIM properties, no group names, no bake buttons: purely a visual geometry preview.
